Getting there & back

From San Miguel de Allende: choose your transport before fixing the shape of the day.

Bus + transfer into town

Search San Miguel de Allende → Guanajuato on Primera Plus. Leave from San Miguel’s Central de Autobuses on Calzada de la Estación. Guanajuato’s terminal is outside the historic centre: continue by taxi or a local bus towards Centro / Mercado Hidalgo.

Book the return too and allow time to reach the terminal. Departures and fares depend on your date.

Check buses ↗︎

A door-to-door driver

Request a return quote with pickup in San Miguel and free time in Guanajuato. This is the simplest option if you want to skip the terminals; confirm the meeting point and return time.

BESTUR ↗︎Daytrip ↗︎

Once in the centre, explore on foot. There are hills and steps: comfortable shoes, water and breaks help.

Just a little planning

Check theatre visitor access, museum hours and funicular service before going. In October, check the Cervantino programme too: events can affect crowds and visits.

Teatro Juárez · Museo Casa Diego Rivera · Festival Cervantino

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider donating to Red Nacional de Refugios to support women and children experiencing domestic violence.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
